bio: Regina Inez Hinojosa ( EE-nə-HOH-sə; Spanish: [inoˈxosa]; born December 8, 1973) is an American politician and lawyer who is the governor-elect of Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 49th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2017. Upon taking office, she is expected to become Texas's first Latina governor, after being declared the victor in the 2026 election.
